title: workspace-standards — one entry point to review, run, and apply every workspace standard
description: Use this when a workspace standard (testing first) must be reviewed, run for a change, or applied to a repository, or when role routing or gates need review. The command /workspace-standards with a verb (review, run, or apply) and a target loads that target's playbook; a target is a foundation (routing, gates) or a registered standard (testing).
author: sox-ecosystem

target.description: A foundation (routing, gates), a registered standard (testing), or the word all (review and apply only; iterates the registry, foundations first).

verb.description: The verb resolved: review, run, or apply.

mode.description: The mode requested with --mode, or null.

playbook.description: Skill-relative path of the playbook the verb loaded (single target).

path.description: Absolute path of that playbook (single target).

order.description: For target all: the iteration order.

items.description: For target all: one entry per registered target.

output_schema.description: On success one JSON object on stdout with exit 0. On failure a named error {ok:false,error:{code,exit,message}} on stderr: E_USAGE 64, E_UNKNOWN_TARGET 2, E_UNSUPPORTED_VERB 3, E_UNKNOWN_VERB 4, E_PLANNED_TARGET 5, E_UNSUPPORTED_MODE 6, E_PLAYBOOK_MISSING 7.
